subject: ART-STATIONS P0 candidates delivered for integration review
body:
# Dedicated station-art delivery

Owner: ART-STATIONS, 2 October 2026. P0 complete as isolated candidates: five new painted transparent identities plus five reusable code-native state-cue overlays. Built-in imagegen was used for all five illustrations. No global imports, UI, engine, progression, certified blueprint, source registry or build output was edited.

## P0 package

Local manifest: `docs/expeditions/v2/station-art-batch-manifest.json`. Runtime root: `assets/expeditions/production/9fo/v2/station-art-batch/runtime/`. High-resolution PNG originals and generation records are retained under `source/`.

| Entity | Base ID | Bytes | Required visual states |
|---|---|---:|---|
| control | four-locks-control-base-v1 | 30,288 | inactive; active plus ready fitting cue; corrupted plus crossed/tangled cue |
| number | four-locks-number-bus-base-v1 | 38,230 | idle; charged plus ready fitting; held plus working cue; damaged plus crack cue |
| shape | four-locks-bridge-brace-base-v1 | 27,446 | idle; charged; held; damaged with the same independent cues |
| sustain | four-locks-tree-maintenance-base-v1 | 42,322 | idle; charged; held; damaged with the same independent cues |
| alcove | four-locks-alcove-base-v1 | 37,450 | unprepared; prepared plus deployed-brace cue; held retains preparation and adds working cue |

Five bases are 175,736 bytes. Five small transparent cue WebPs are 1,936 bytes. P0 total: 177,672 bytes, approximately 174 KiB. Bases are sRGB 384 square, uniformly resized with transparent padding. Every base has one connected alpha component, zero detached pixels and passes the existing alpha validator. No checkerboard, white matte or clipped root/lever/tool is visible in the four-background reviews. All bases read distinctly at 96px; 48px previews retain identity but numerical values require live detail/zoom.

The cues are code-native state badges, not additional painted mechanism illustrations. They make state differences structural rather than colour-only. Display upright at a minimum 14 screen pixels. The held state contains no permanently painted hero. Damage, ready and held can coexist: see the last column of the Number/Shape/Sustain comparison sheets. Preparation persists under held. The alcove has no independent charge or integrity: optional linked damage uses Shape's integrity and must be described as linked Shape damage.

## Integration contract

Resolve stations by family/entity ID, not the immutable blueprint's provisional `artId`. Current `orchardArtFor` returns no station sprite, so all five still reach StationGlyph. The new resolver records are ready for the builder to add; this delivery has not wired them. Keep `orchard` mapped to the existing separate `hero-ninefoldtree-idle`, never to the maintenance pump or the whole apple-tree terrain tile.

Manifest main coordinates are prepared runtime pixels; `sourcePixels` explicitly records original PNG dimensions, bounds, anchor and safe rectangle with the uniform transform. Ground anchor is [192,330] for every base. At a 96px sprite canvas, use one uniform scale 0.25 and place that anchor at the engine-projected tile centre. Props have transparent margins, no painted terrain hex and leave room for an adjacent 72px Pip in the composition. Builder must verify actual overlap, depth order and phone zoom before acceptance.

Control active means `state.puzzleValid`. Inactive is initially false; corruption requires false validity and a real `puzzle-disrupted` event, not a changed free draft. Do not add a control charge meter. For Number/Shape/Sustain, ready means charge at least blueprint capacity, held means a real `state.holds[entityId]`, damage means integrity below maximum. These predicates are independent. Alcove preparation is `state.preparedAlcove`; held is `state.holds.alcove`, never `state.holds.shape`. Keep all puzzle grids, cages, mathematical glyphs, labels, live values and holder names in code. Selection/focus/target and connections remain exact code geometry.

Order: base; preparation/ready fitting cue; working cue; damage/corruption cue; live values and selection. Give stacked badges separate positions. Do not paint over the documented blank rectangles. State cues must return from temporary action animation according to real state; never use a timer to infer Hold or preparation.

## P1 reuse and effects

The existing objective tree figure is clean, selected and suitable. The whole `terrain-apple-tree-v1` is a scenic tile rather than a workstation. Current grass/path/roots/water/hedge/bridge materials are already in scene-kit. The actual bridge renderer reads `state.passages[hex].open`; preserve `closingPending` safety-interlock feedback and exact code hit geometry. Damage needs a separate visible linked-site cue rather than making a closed bridge look permanently destroyed.

Existing gate `mechanism-orchard-lockdown-gate-v1` and living-root barrier are recognisable skins, currently unwired in v2. Existing `po-fx-guard-v1.webp` is suitable shelter/protection art. Existing `po-rooststorm-front-v2.png` supplies a wind/storm effect; actual range, affected enemies and orchard cost stay live. `po-rooststorm-beam-sweep-v2.png` is suitable visual beam paint only: direction, start/end, active sectors and exclusions must remain code. Existing root/pulse and corruption illustrations are ornamental; prefer restrained live protection/corruption badges when their baked decorative connections could misstate the rules. No effect may imply that Roots prevents a Breaker's in-range strike.

Effects were visually reviewed in `qa/existing-effects-contact.png`: top row beam, storm, shield, stabilised/corrupted; bottom row forecast, damage, pulse, guard. Filenames alone were not used as acceptance. Remaining effect export/import accounting belongs to the builder's selected-art gate.

## QA and limitations

`qa/identities-{white,black,green,cyan}.png`, per-identity four backgrounds, 48/96/192 scale sheets, labelled state comparisons, safe-area sheets and `qa/hex-hero-composition.png` were produced and inspected. Composition uses an exact pointy hex of side 42 and a representative separate hero. These are isolated asset compositions, not actual App acceptance. Full metadata includes bytes, SHA-256, bounds, alpha diagnostics, anchor, safe areas, state predicates and QA paths.

Preparation emits font-cache warnings in this restricted environment but completes PNG export. No shared rebuild or regression is required or run. The bus's first built-in generation failed with `network error: error sending request`; retry succeeded. Original generated files and sources remain intact. Final browser/device review stays with builder and scrum.

## Continuing bounded production

Audit covers all five approved families and shared systems. The other four are requirements rather than live generators: actual generation/index.js currently regenerates Four Locks only. Existing scale, tower, wheel, branches, UI frames and hero/enemy preparation are reused; unselected poses and concrete alpha defects remain with their existing owner. Next concrete missing illustrations: a wind-specific stabiliser fitting and a small isolated packing socket. Their derivatives will append to this local manifest without changing global registries. This is not a claim that all 25 tiers or all modules are complete.
